title: Conservation of Momentum
text: In an isolated system, total momentum before collision equals total momentum after. This is the Law of Conservation of Linear Momentum.

title: Inelastic Collision
text: When objects stick together, it's called a perfectly inelastic collision. The combined mass moves with a common velocity v after collision.

title: Setting Up the Equation
text: Total momentum before: m₁v₁ + m₂v₂. Total momentum after: (m₁ + m₂)v. These must be equal.
